result:
**Round 85 verdict: PASS.** `browserVerified=true` and `realVerified=true`. I checked everything in a real browser at 1440x900 and 1280x720, as an anonymous user with no credentials. I changed no app source. At the end the repository is exactly as A left it: HEAD `88b0262`, 6 modified + 4 new files, frozen list 481/481, A's end hashes match, `ArrangementClip.tsx` untouched, protected and auth files unchanged.

**Header fix (C-R84-M1):**
- I scrolled the video fade handle, the audio fade handle and both trim strips under the track header, with the clip selected and unselected. The header is the topmost element in all 8 cases at both sizes.
- A real 40 px drag at those spots changed no fade or start time, added no Undo entry and wrote no status.
- One gap: at the trim-strip spot the drag landed on the header's Volume slider, and I didn't record its value before and after. Only the unchanged Undo label shows the slider didn't change.
- When a dragged clip's outline goes under the SFX header, no outline pixels appear on the header.
- Envelope points under the header are covered, and a click on Mute there toggles Mute.
- In the visible lane area nothing changed: fade, trim and envelope drags still work, the selected clip's outline shows over its neighbour, and the playhead line shows over clips.
- I also checked the group header row the code reviewer flagged as unchecked; it covers clips correctly.

**Range export (SRW-20 stage 1):**
- With a 4–9 s selection, Export picks the selection by default, with the exact label. The file `czaba-studio-lab-range.wav` has exactly 240,000 frames (24-bit, 48 kHz, stereo). It matches the same 5 seconds of a whole-project export within 1 LSB (the smallest 24-bit step).
- That match also holds:
  - when a fade and a volume envelope cross the selection start;
  - when the selection is drawn on another lane;
  - when the selection covers all lanes.
- The whole-project export, its file name and its message are unchanged.
- **Overload warning:** at Master +6 dB a quiet span gives no warning and a loud span gives +7.5 dBFS and 5,252 samples, matching the file (5,252) and the prediction (7.48 dB). I muted the music track to get a quiet span, and the report says so.
- **Keyboard:** works end to end, and focus never leaves the dialog.
- **MP3 and video options:** both stay disabled with their reasons, and only `.wav` files download.
- **Selection past the project end:** the UI can't create one, because a selection is clamped to the clip. The task says that is not a fail. A selection running up to the project end exports correctly.

**Purchase protection:** `/studio/middle-east` asks for sign-in, the token API returns 401 without login, and `/studio-lab` makes no token or R2 requests. The fake-Bearer check is BLOCKED because the backend isn't available here (it returns 500).

A's 65 targeted test files pass (1,151 tests). Full test suite, build and verify are left to the root gate.

**Findings for B (both Low, neither blocks the round):**
- **C-R85-L1:** Escape doesn't cancel a clip drag; the move is saved when you release. This was already the case before this round. The task assumed Escape cancels, and I don't know what Ableton does here.
- **C-R85-L2:** with no selection, the "whole project" option is also greyed out, not only the selection option. A did this to keep a frozen focus test passing. Export still works. B should accept it or allow that test to change in a later round.
- **Note on C-R84-L1:** the 1 LSB difference between two exports of the same project also happens without any video, between 4 and 9 s. It stays within tolerance and isn't caused by range export.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-85.md
- c-round-85.json
- c-browse.json
- c-round-85/ (scripts, per-viewport results, screenshots, checkpoint)
